author: qmpageball98
quote: The plot is atrocious, the characters are boring and soft, the missions have guardrails on them it is very difficult to fail in this game. I don’t understand what happened. They had an unlimited budget and they screwed up the entire game. Beyond the plot the actual gameplay mechanics have me scratching my head. The new wanted system is somewhat interesting I guess but I already find it extremely tedious and I’m only 10 hours in… they absolutely butchered helicopters I can’t believe how terrible of a job they did. Driving was also definitely more fun in 5. Rockstar, how could you fail this hard this consistently. Just bad.
